notes.title: Save Your Favorites 🔥
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got some exciting news!

A much-requested feature is finally here: Now you have 9 slots to save your favorite characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585775/2e28e99ab6b8e7c6201cd0f8905bc0b1e705666d.jpg[/img]

We’ve also made various bug fixes and improved some animations&poses to make everything feel smoother and more dynamic. 

Thanks for all your support and feedback—you're amazing 💛

Keep having fun!

notes.title: VR Naughty is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone 👋

We’re thrilled to finally share VR Naughty with you. We poured our hearts—and a few guilty pleasures—into this game, and we hope you can also find something to love or.. You know ♥ 

Thank you to everyone who's supported us along the way. 

So—what are you waiting for? 

Come join the fun!
